text.en:
The sum of thirty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine
Treasury, not otherwise appropriated, as a contribution for the operation and maintenance of the Junior
College of Liberal Arts of the University of the Philippines in the municipality of Cebu, Province of Cebu,
during the fiscal year nineteen hundred and thirty-six.

This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and thirty-six.
Approved, December 31, 1935.
